hero.title: Paddle the Selby coast with someone who knows its tides
hero.text: Day trips, multi-day journeys and coaching for small groups, from first strokes to open crossings.
hero.text2: I have guided on this coast for fourteen years. Groups are never larger than six.
hero.note: April to October; winter coaching on request

statement.title: The sea decides the day
statement.text: Every trip is planned around the morning's forecast and the tide. If it is not safe to go, we do not go, and you pay nothing.

steps.text: Choose by how far you want to go.

items.title: Island crossing
items.text: Two days out to Gull Holm and back, camping on the island.

items.title: Coaching
items.text: One to one or two to one, on the skills you choose.

catalogue.title: Days and prices
catalogue.text: Prices are per person and include kayak, paddle, buoyancy aid and dry suit.
catalogue.note: Full refund when I cancel for weather; 14 days' notice for your own cancellation.

plans.text: For paddlers working towards a leader award or their first crossing.
plans.note: Blocks are booked as days within one season.

items.text: I grew up in Selby Haven and have paddled every bay of this coast. Before guiding I was a lifeboat crew member for six years.

items.q: Do I need to be able to swim?
items.a: You should be comfortable in water; you will wear a buoyancy aid at all times.
Clothes that can get wet, a warm layer, and lunch for a full day.

items.q: What happens if the weather is bad?
items.a: I decide on the morning; you choose another date or get your money back.
